_comment: RunPod POST /v1/pods body. Replace VLLM_API_KEY's placeholder with a random token at launch; never commit it. Port 8001 serves only /logs (startup log and nvidia-smi).
name: ab-vllm-qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-fp8
dockerStartCmd: mkdir -p /logs; cd /logs; (python3 -m http.server 8001 --directory /logs >/dev/null 2>&1 &); nvidia-smi > /logs/nvidia-smi.txt 2>&1; python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 --revision d9748a51ae66354c4dad665aab2c71f26cf2c8cd --served-model-name qwen3-vl-30b-a3b --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --max-model-len 8192 --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 16}' --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --seed 0 --no-enable-prefix-caching 2>&1 | tee /logs/vllm.log
